title: Grade and tonnage above a cut-off
statement: blocks.csv is a block model (columns block_id, x, y, z, tonnes, grade_gpt, domain). For blocks in the "sulphide" domain with grade at or above 1 g/t, report the total tonnes, the tonnage-weighted mean grade in g/t, and the contained gold in troy ounces.
instructions: The team's procedure: 1. Keep only blocks in the stated domain. 2. Keep blocks whose grade is at or above the cut-off. 3. Sum their tonnes. 4. Take the mean grade weighted by tonnes (a simple average of block grades is wrong when blocks differ in size). 5. Contained ounces = sum of (tonnes x grade) / 31.1035.
